headline: Divided Fronts See Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, the struggle has widened and intensified across the divided sectors. Weathered Expanse now leads the ledger with 52 strategic-base events in 24 hours, including eight in the latest two; its present count is seven Colonial-held and two Warden-held bases, while casualty pressure remains heavy and Warden losses are accelerating. Stlican Shelf has risen from 38 to 46 events, with eleven in two hours, and its divided count stands at six Colonial and three Warden bases. Linn Mercy has likewise quickened, recording six recent events and 19 across the day; eight bases are Colonial-held and three Warden-held. Callahan’s Passage has advanced from nine to 16 events, four of them recent, though nine of its ten bases remain Warden-held and one Colonial-held. Marban Hollow is another active contest, with two events in two hours and 13 in the day, while its ledger shows seven Colonial and one Warden base. Deadlands has quieted in the latest two hours but still logged 16 daily events, leaving all eleven bases Colonial-held. Godcrofts retains a turbulent 21-event record, though only one event arrived in six hours.
